subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: What is the supported lifecycle for cron quarantine recovery data when a sidecar exceeds its size cap?
rationale: The implementation can either preserve recovery data indefinitely, delete it under a retention rule, or require operator action; selecting among those data-retention and operational behaviors requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Doctor-managed recovery cleanup
options.body: Keep the bounded reader and make Doctor detect, preserve, and explicitly clean or migrate oversized quarantine recovery artifacts.

options.title: Approved automatic retention
options.body: Adopt a documented archive count or age limit with upgrade behavior and tests, accepting automatic deletion of older recovery data.

options.title: No archive rotation
options.body: Reject the rotation path and retain only bounded-read failure reporting until a recovery lifecycle is designed.

recommendation.title: Doctor-managed recovery cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded reader and make Doctor detect, preserve, and explicitly clean or migrate oversized quarantine recovery artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline indicates awareness of this PR, and the unresolved choice is repository-level persisted-recovery policy.
